titleEn: Sanovo, CET to unveil D4 egg-sexing system at IPPE 2027
titleZh: Sanovo与CET将在IPPE 2027发布D4蛋性别鉴定系统
summaryZh: Sanovo科技集团、加拿大蛋业技术公司（CET）与MatrixSpec Solutions联合开发了D4非破坏性在卵蛋性别鉴定系统，计划于2027年1月IPPE展会正式亮相。该技术采用高光谱成像，可在孵化第4天准确鉴定胚胎性别，并可通过平台升级推进至孵化前（第0天）鉴定，无需大量额外资本支出。系统可释放40%-60%孵化器容量，避免雄性胚胎进入痛觉感知阶段，符合国际动物福利标准，且适用于各种规模的孵化场。
featuredReason: 该技术代表了蛋鸡孵化行业在动物福利与智能化方面的重大突破，高光谱成像结合在卵性别鉴定可显著提升孵化效率、降低资源消耗，且具备从D4向D0升级的清晰路径，对关注家禽智能化养殖和动物福利的从业者具有重要参考价值。
contentFull:
In-ovo sexing
 

 

 
 
 Sanovo, CET to unveil D4 egg-sexing system at IPPE 2027
 

 Technology to advance toward pre-incubation sexing

 

 
 
 
 
 29 September 2026
 
 

 
 
 
 1 minute read
 
 

 
 
 
 By: Global Ag Media 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 North America

 

 

 

 

 Representatives from the Sanovo Technology Group, Canadian Egg Technologies (CET), and MatrixSpec Solutions met in Odense, Denmark last week to discuss plans to launch their day four (D4) non-destructive in-ovo egg sexing system at the International Production & Processing Expo (IPPE) in January 2027, according to Canadian Egg Technologies. Attendees will be able to view the technology in person and learn more from the team behind it.

The Canadian-developed technology is described as the only commercial in-ovo sexing system designed to advance from early-incubation (day 4) sex detection to pre-incubation (day 0) sexing. At IPPE, industry leaders will see how the hatchery-ready equipment integrates into existing hatchery operations of any size, and how the system can advance from D4 to D0 sexing through a platform upgrade without requiring significant further capital expenditure.

The hyperspectral imaging technology, developed jointly by SANOVO, CET, and MatrixSpec Solutions, currently enables accurate, non-destructive sex determination as early as day four of incubation. The system is hatchery-validated and designed to scale across operations of all sizes, from independent hatcheries to large facilities, integrating into existing processes using equipment commonly found in hatcheries worldwide.

By enabling in-ovo sex determination at D4, the companies say the technology allows hatcheries to identify infertile and male embryos well in advance of the onset of nociception, a benchmark established by major international animal welfare organizations. The technology is also designed to reduce resource consumption across the hatch cycle without requiring expensive consumables or significant electrical energy, while freeing up 40% to 60% more incubator capacity at D4 for viable female eggs.

translationZh:
Sanovo科技集团、加拿大蛋业技术公司（CET）与MatrixSpec Solutions的代表上周在丹麦欧登塞会面，讨论了在2027年1月国际生产与加工博览会（IPPE）上发布其第四天（D4）非破坏性在卵蛋性别鉴定系统的计划。据加拿大蛋业技术公司称，与会者将能够现场观看该技术，并向其背后的团队了解更多信息。

这项加拿大开发的技术被描述为唯一一款商业化的在卵性别鉴定系统，旨在从孵化早期（第4天）性别检测推进至孵化前（第0天）性别鉴定。在IPPE上，行业领袖将看到这款即用型孵化设备如何整合到任何规模的现有孵化场运营中，以及该系统如何通过平台升级从D4推进至D0性别鉴定，而无需大量额外资本支出。

该高光谱成像技术由SANOVO、CET和MatrixSpec Solutions联合开发，目前能够在孵化第4天即实现准确、非破坏性的性别判定。该系统已经过孵化场验证，设计上可扩展至各种规模的运营——从独立孵化场到大型设施——利用全球孵化场常见的设备即可整合到现有流程中。

通过在D4实现在卵性别判定，这些公司表示，该技术使孵化场能够在痛觉感知开始之前很早就识别出无精蛋和雄性胚胎，痛觉感知基准由主要国际动物福利组织制定。该技术还旨在减少整个孵化周期的资源消耗，无需昂贵的耗材或大量电力，同时在D4为可存活雌性种蛋释放40%至60%的额外孵化器容量。
